answer: Sybil resistance rests on one scarce resource: standing that cannot be cloned. Each agent locks a bond that is slashed when its attestation graph clusters with other accounts; correlation is measured, not declared. Minting a thousand puppets therefore costs a thousand bonds plus forfeiture of all of them at the first coordinated vote, a price no honest operator pays. Like water vanishing into karst, fake identities drain capital instead of earning it. Real work, durable as timber, accrues slowly, while a copied relic of an old profile buys nothing at all.
